Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing - Acme Robotics (call recap + options)

Hi Alice / Tom,

Thanks again for the details and the spreadsheet. Quick recap and two configuration options for your review before our sizing call: 

Recap of your inputs:
- Sustained TPS: ~30 current, target provisioned 50 TPS sustained
- Peak bursts: up to ~110 TPS (short windows), want headroom to 120 TPS
- Token mix: avg prompt 150 / gen 250 (~400 tokens total); ~20% embedding/rerank traffic
- Concurrency: 40-60 total concurrent model invocations at peak; per-session concurrency ~6-10
- Context: 8k windows, KV-cache warm-starts acceptable
- GPU preference: H100 preferred but budget-sensitive

Configuration options (preliminary):
1) Committed-reserved (recommended for predictable latency/cost):
   - 6x H100 dedicated GPUs in a reserved pool
   - Should cover sustained 50 TPS and 120 TPS bursts without relying on ephemeral capacity
   - Autoscaling set to replace any node failures + 20% headroom for autoscaling lag

2) Hybrid (lower committed cost, operational burst):
   - 4x H100 reserved + 2x ephemeral H100s for burst windows
   - Ephemeral nodes spin up for 5-15 minute peaks; reduces committed monthly cost but requires burst policy and scheduling ops

Technical assumptions: dynamic batching (max_batch_size 64), ~8 concurrent on-GPU RPCs, NVMe model cache per node, 25 Gbps inter-node network for KV sync. p95 latency target < 250ms.

Attachments: I added a short proposal PDF with estimated costs and delta vs hosted API. Rafael / Aditya 1 please skim and confirm GPU memory/token-per-second assumptions before the call.

If Thu 3/12 10:30 PT still works, we'll lock the invite for 30 minutes (agenda: confirm model variants & memory, finalize node counts, agree POC timeline).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
